_comment: Pinned FFmpeg binaries. Single source of truth for BOTH consumers:
* runtime  - livecap_cli/resources/ffmpeg_pins.py (packaged data, Issue #398)
* CI       - .github/actions/setup-livecap-ffmpeg/setup_ffmpeg.py (Issue #395)
Platform keys are the upstream ffbinaries tokens, not either consumer's own
naming. Each consumer maps its inputs onto these: CI from RUNNER_OS/RUNNER_ARCH,
runtime from platform.system()/platform.machine().
Pinning makes runs comparable across OSes and across time. It does NOT make
behaviour identical: build configuration and the set of enabled codecs still
differ between builds. Never read this as 'same version = same behaviour'.
'archives.sha256' is verified right after download, before extraction.
'binaries.sha256' is verified after extraction, on every CI cache restore, and
whenever the runtime cannot trust its stamp file - so the check never depends
on where the bytes came from.
'cache_generation' is CI-only: bump it to invalidate every actions/cache entry
without changing a pinned value (e.g. after a poisoned-cache warning). Changing
anything else in this file already changes the CI cache key, which embeds this
file's SHA-256.
Platforms deliberately absent (see Issue #398 D4): win-32 has no upstream asset
at all; macOS arm64 has none either, and running the Intel build under Rosetta 2
silently is not acceptable; linux arm assets exist but are unpinned because we
have no way to verify them. All of these fail loud with instructions instead.
To change the pinned version see 'SHA-256 refresh' in
.github/actions/setup-livecap-ffmpeg/README.md. Never hand-type a hash.

note: These binaries are fetched from a third party onto the user's machine and
invoked as a separate process. livecap-cli (AGPL-3.0) does not redistribute
them and does not link against them.
The ffbinaries-prebuilt repository declares no SPDX license and has not been
updated since 2023-12-28, so v6.1 is pinned because it is the newest release
available - not merely because CI uses it. Raising the pin means re-evaluating
the supplier, and must be recorded in CHANGELOG.md.
